title: F1 - data/functions/<function_id>.json
description: The 541 mechanical function records. FOUNDATION 2.4 gives deltas only; the base field set is the existing organ.

efh.propertyOrderEvidence: All 541 files at data/functions/*.json emit exactly two key orders (537 files without text_integrity, 4 with it), and the 24-key order below is a prefix-consistent superset of both. FOUNDATION 2.4 line 168 says 'The existing 26 fields stay' but does not list them and does not state where the new fields insert; the observed order is the only traceable statement of the contract, so it is what is recorded here. The 26-vs-observed-21-base discrepancy is recorded in tools/schemas/README.md and not resolved by invention.
efh.keyOrderContract: Emit keys in propertyOrder exactly. axis_provenance, classification, axes and vintage are data-keyed objects emitted in ordinal key order per FOUNDATION 2.3 line 160.

pendingRequired.schema: FOUNDATION 2.3 line 161 says 'Every file carries schema'. No F1 file at HEAD carries one and no delta in 2.4 adds one, so it is not in required. Recorded, not invented.

function_id.description: R. Join key for F2, F5.subjects, F6, F16.

metadata_status.description: R. Stays in the file and is NEVER rendered - FOUNDATION 2.4 line 181.

max.description: DELTA D-2 (FOUNDATION 2.4 line 176): render usize::MAX as 'unbounded', never 18446744073709551615.

arity.description: R. DELTA D-1 (line 174): sourced from the live registry, not the 2026-04-02 dirty-tree CSV. Gated on STEWARD DECISION SD-2, which is decided: take delta D-1.

classification.description: R. May be the empty object (13 entries at HEAD have no live-registry classification). DELTA D-1.

axes.description: R, may be null. axes.axes_version stays in the file and is NEVER rendered - FOUNDATION 2.4 line 181.

oxfunc_tier.description: DELTA D-4, FOUNDATION 2.4 line 175. Gates rendering; also feeds the build-time chip_suppression rule that A3-S8 removed from F4.

axis_provenance.description: R (new, DELTA D-3). Per axis key.

trailing_repeats.description: DELTA D-5 (FOUNDATION 2.4 line 176): null when parameters is empty. The true on 8 operators is a derivation artifact and is false.

short_source.description: R (new, DELTA D-6, FOUNDATION 2.4 line 177). 'no-short-description' is reserved for built-in operators, whose syntax tokens have no Microsoft function-help article.
short_source.efhObservationNote: The complete-help projection emits 'microsoft-english-verbatim' on all 518 built-in functions, using the official English help text when the registry short is absent. The 23 operators remain honestly exempt with 'no-short-description'. 'differs-from-english-description' occurs on 0 files.

localized_names.description: R. Contains only function-resolved harvested names. Shared published-row labels, unresolved shared-article rows, and missing function-specific rows remain in F18 and leave this array empty; `localization` states why.

function_article_guid.description: Microsoft Support article GUID extracted from the selected docs object; null only when no function article is known.

status.description: Allowed pairs are function/article_unique, shared_article/english_name_match, shared_published_row/combined_row, shared_article/unresolved_shared_guid, and function/missing_source_row. Completeness tests enforce the pairs and current inventories.

article_row_count.description: Rows in F18 carrying this article GUID: 40 for a complete one-row-per-locale article, 400 for the shared ten-row IS article, or 0 when absent.

resolved_name_count.description: Must equal localized_names length; 40 only for article_unique or english_name_match, otherwise 0.

localization.description: R. Object for every built-in function; null explicitly marks operators as outside the function-name localization source.

artifacts.description: R, may be null. Non-null on 40 of 541; F2.declared_artifacts_present mirrors it.

version_marker.description: R. null in all 541 files - FOUNDATION 7.9 line 1324: the Handbook cannot answer 'from which Excel version' for any function.

text_integrity.description: O (new, DELTA D-7, FOUNDATION 2.4 line 178). These three mechanical fields ONLY. A3-S6: suspected_lost and verified move to F12 as a lossy-text gap, because an inference may not sit in mechanical data/.

oxfunc_tree_clean.description: R (new, DELTA D-8, FOUNDATION 2.4 line 179). false blocks publication of this file. A3-S12.

vintage.description: R (new, DELTA D-8, FOUNDATION 2.4 line 179). Maps each field group to the OxFunc state it came from. FOUNDATION names ten groups and required lists exactly those ten; the generated organ emits nineteen keys (a superset), which is permitted by additionalProperties and recorded in tools/schemas/README.md. Feeds absence string A-09's replacement, the permanent basis clause (FOUNDATION 4.2 lines 849-854).
